nl_sentences: The table provided categorizes mental health disorders using ICD codes for classification.
ICD codes are structured to group related conditions under broad diagnostic ranges.
The range **F00-F09** covers organic mental disorders, including symptomatic conditions.
**F20-F29** encompasses schizophrenia, schizotypal disorders, and delusional disorders.
Mood or affective disorders are classified under the **F30-F39** code range.
Neurotic, stress-related, and somatoform disorders fall within **F40-F48**.
Behavioral syndromes linked to physiological disturbances are listed under **F50-F59**.
Disorders of adult personality and behavior are categorized in the **F60-F69** range.
The **F80-F89** section addresses disorders of psychological development.
Behavioral and emotional disorders with childhood onset are split across two rows in the table.
These childhood-onset disorders are specifically coded under **F90-F98**.
The **F99** code is reserved for unspecified mental disorders not fitting other categories.
This structure ensures systematic documentation for insurance and clinical purposes.
